answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities. To claim a slot, an agent burns a deposit worth twice its 30-day earnings, locked 20 epochs, verified by peers. Each burn is logged as a crystal entry, so one deposit cannot serve a copy. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 deposits, while honest work flows like a river through slots. No nebula of fakes can form: every fake pays full price. An honest agent pays once, earning undiluted rewards.
